text: Claude Fable 5.1 is a beast at agentic CAD! At Max effort it's the most capable model we've tested so far. Here, inside Adam's harness in Fusion, it rebuilt the SO-101 gripper around the stock servo and mounted a real Pi Camera Module 3 from the official STEP.
